purpose: QA75 solve-distillation FINISHING stage (pn1-S5 revived): finish/train the tr1 renderer to MATCH the EXACT-solve on the QA74 attack set, sidestepping the CE-vs-argmax wall. Fires as the burn's finishing stage OR post-burn, informed by QA74's typed split (distill ONLY the amortization-gap regions).

teacher.role: compress-time TEACHER — never ships (strict-scorer rule bars only DECODE-time scorer loads); teacher rate is FREE at compress time
teacher.archive_form: 409.5MB (r6cal SHA-bound settled control); frames/labels NOT materialized as arrays

attack_set.definition: the QA74 amortization-gap pixels = renderer flips MINUS the exact-solve concede floor (>=96.1% of the 458,621 renderer flips)
priority_by_class: Lane (175,075 gap, 38.7% of flips, 25.7% err-rate, 69.5x over floor)
attack_set.spatial: grid rows 5-19 (SegNet 80-320); 80% of mass in rows 160-240; the 384 cell_drop50-kept cells (99.61% flip mass)
attack_set.margin: the bottom GT-margin decile (the codim-1 boundary annulus) — 100% of flips
attack_set.concede_excluded: the 17,927 exact-solve-floor pixels are EXCLUDED from the distill target (the solve also fails there = GT/realization floor)

loss.form: KD (#74 lineage): match the SOLVED representation on the attack set. Two admissible surfaces (RACE): (a) label-match — CE/argmax against the exact-solve argmax labels on the attack set only; (b) frame-match — L2/feature match against the exact-solve RGB frames (the solve's R-REALIZABLE representation, which is the distinct value over plain CE-against-GT).
loss.restrict: attack-set mask (per-pixel) — do NOT distill the bulk (already at floor) nor the concede floor (unreachable)
loss.compose_with: the QA24 burn seg loss (margin-weighted) as a FINISHING stage after basin-entry, OR a post-burn stage on the frozen burn endpoint

materialization_blocker.blocker: the exact-solve per-pixel argmax labels AND RGB frames are NOT materialized (409.5MB archive-form; lv1 materialization blocker). QA75 as a FULL solve-distillation requires inflating the exact-solve archive -> per-pixel target labels/frames via the v10_production_receiver (receiver_contract tac.witness_dsl.v10_production_receiver.v1).
materialization_blocker.materializable_proxy_note: the GT-frame projection (= the existing --token-init-mode solve_project) is already the init; the DISTINCT QA75 value (the solve's R-realizable representation on the attack pixels) needs the inflate. A cheaper partial: the exact-solve per-CLASS/per-PAIR error COUNTS are materialized (receipt) — sufficient to WEIGHT the attack set, not to provide per-pixel targets.
materialization_blocker.owed_step: inflate 04_candidate/0.bin (or archive.zip, sha e3d0581f...) through the v10 production receiver -> exact-solve argmax (600,384,512) + RGB frames -> the distill targets

falsifier.rule: distilled endpoint d_seg vs CE endpoint at MATCHED counted bytes/budget
falsifier.target_limited: distilled STRICTLY < CE endpoint -> the amortization gap is DISTILLATION-curable (the solve's realizable representation is the mechanism) -> QA75 is the lead rung
falsifier.optimization_limited: distilled ~= CE endpoint -> the gap is optimization-limited (the QA24 form fixes / coarse grid are the mechanism, not distillation) -> QA75 does not lead
falsifier.authority: n600 realized d_seg through the real render+R+SegNet, byte-closed; [macOS-CPU advisory] until an exact contest row

consumes: QA24 burn endpoint (the base to finish)
wire_in: the tr1 trainer consumes this as a stage config (a new stage 'seg_trunk_distill' after 'seg_trunk_tau'), OR a standalone post-burn finisher; gated on the materialization owed_step above.
